Q: Stream on mongo replicat set returns duplicate documents A:

Finally it was not the stream neither the spliterator but our API gateway was replaying the request 3 times after the timeout.

Q: Laravel filament, issue uploading file A:

In my case I solved this by changing variables_order in php.ini

- variables_order="EGPCS"   // <- from this
+ variables_order="GPCS"    // <- to this

More info https://www.php.net/manual/en/ini.core.php#ini.variables-order

Q: Oracle sub-partition shows data, but oracle query using filter does not show data A:

Probably, what you're actually after is something like:

select *
from   NPM.EH_MODEM_HIST_PRFRM_FACT
where  time_stamp >= to_date('23/01/2016', 'dd/mm/yyyy')
and    time_stamp < to_date('23/01/2016', 'dd/mm/yyyy') + 1
and    site_id = 580;

The above assumes that the datatype for the time_stamp column is DATE. If it's actually TIMESTAMP then you should use the SQL below:

select *
from   NPM.EH_MODEM_HIST_PRFRM_FACT
where  time_stamp >= to_date('23/01/2016', 'dd/mm/yyyy')
and    time_stamp < to_date('23/01/2016', 'dd/mm/yyyy') + interval '1' day
and    site_id = 580;

Note also that I have specified the date with a four digit year. Two digit years are just soooo pre-y2k! *{;-)

Q: delete_cookies() helper not working in codeigniter 4 A:

I had the same issue. If you also have a redirect to login page after the delete_cookie

return redirect()->to("login")

it will return a separate RedirectResponse object that doesn't inherit cookies queued via delete_cookie() on the response.

You need ->withCookies() chained on to carry them over to login

return redirect()->to("login")->withCookies();
